0022600105.text: Brooklyn is 0-1 and sits 10th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Atlantic, while Cleveland is also 0-1, 13th in the East and 1 game back in the Central. Tyler Bilodeau is out for the Nets with a shoulder injury, and this is Brooklyn's second game of the season on the road. The teams have not played yet in 2026-27, the Nets lost 0-3 in the 2025-26 season series, and their last meeting, in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026, ended 106-102 in Cleveland's favor.
